ir.name: pairwise_margin_adaptive_scaled_bias_v8_clamped_weight_repaired_v2
ir.intuition: Clamp weights with eps addition and ensure numerical stability with proper weight clamping and stable bias scaling using delta_rank; preserves original adaptive scaled bias and margin logic.
ir.pseudocode:
eps = 1e-6
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
weight = batch['weight']
weight = clamp(weight, min=eps) + eps
delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
alpha, bias, gamma = get from extra with defaults
abs_mean = mean(abs(delta_rank)) + eps
mean_delta = mean(delta_rank)
diff = delta_rank - mean_delta
var = mean(diff^2) + eps
std = sqrt(var)
cv = std / abs_mean
beta = 0.15 * sigmoid(-15*(cv-0.2))
sp_arg = 0.5 * delta_rank
bias_dyn = bias * softplus(sp_arg) / (abs_mean + 0.2)
scaled_bias = tanh(gamma * bias_dyn)
margin = lpw - lpl
margin_scale_raw = std / (abs_mean + 0.1)
margin_scale = 1.3 * sigmoid(12*(margin_scale_raw - 0.15))
scaled_margin = margin * margin_scale
weighted_margin = alpha * scaled_margin - beta * delta_rank
biased_margin = weighted_margin + scaled_bias
x = clamp(biased_margin, -14, 14)
loss = -logsigmoid(x) * weight
return mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    weight = ops.clamp(weight, min=eps)
    weight = ops.add(weight, weight.new_ones(weight.shape) * eps)
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    bias = float(extra.get('bias', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('bias', 0.5)))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', 2.0))

    abs_delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(ops.abs(delta_rank))
    abs_delta_rank_mean = ops.add(abs_delta_rank_mean, eps)
    delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(delta_rank)
    diff = ops.sub(delta_rank, delta_rank_mean)
    delta_rank_var = ops.mean(ops.mul(diff, diff))
    delta_rank_var = ops.add(delta_rank_var, eps)
    delta_rank_std = ops.sqrt(delta_rank_var)

    cv = ops.div(delta_rank_std, abs_delta_rank_mean)
    beta = ops.mul(0.15, ops.sigmoid(ops.neg(ops.mul(15.0, ops.sub(cv, 0.2)))))

    sp_arg = ops.mul(0.5, delta_rank)
    bias_dynamic = ops.div(ops.mul(bias, ops.softplus(sp_arg)), ops.add(abs_delta_rank_mean, 0.2))
    scaled_bias = ops.tanh(ops.mul(gamma, bias_dynamic))

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin_scale_raw = ops.div(delta_rank_std, ops.add(abs_delta_rank_mean, 0.1))
    margin_scale = ops.mul(1.3, ops.sigmoid(ops.mul(12.0, ops.sub(margin_scale_raw, 0.15))))
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(margin, margin_scale)

    weighted_margin = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, scaled_margin), ops.mul(beta, delta_rank))
    biased_margin = ops.add(weighted_margin, scaled_bias)

    x = ops.clamp(biased_margin, -14.0, 14.0)

    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)

    loss = ops.mean(weighted_loss)
    return loss
